qs.q: Global health agencies monitor influenza surveillance data for emergence of pandemic strains. Antigenic shift, which produces novel strains capable of causing worldwide pandemics, occurs primarily through:
o: Deletions within the neuraminidase stem-loop structures
Accumulation of point mutations in viral hemagglutinin genes
Recombination between human and avian viral DNA genomes
Reassortment of segmented viral genomes in co-infected hosts
Epigenetic silencing of viral polymerase genes in culture
qs.e: Antigenic shift results from the genetic reassortment of segmented RNA genomes when a host is co-infected with different strains.
